evidence_boundary: This is a preparation curriculum derived from limited public and candidate-reported evidence. It does not claim to reproduce a confidential or officially published selection-test syllabus.

sources.title: ASEAN Scholarships applicant information
supports: Selection-test administration exists within the scholarship process.

sources.title: Recent candidate report supplied by the product owner
supports: Section 1 reportedly contained sentence vocabulary, banked cloze, open cloze and two reading passages.
Section 2 was reported as 30 minutes with an approximately 300-word composition.
sources.limitations: One candidate account cannot establish official or enduring counts, marks, prompt choices or word-limit wording. Recalled live questions must not be copied.
